decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several mid-range portable speakers focusing on the balance between wattage (sound power), waterproofing, and customer satisfaction. The Raymate speaker stood out because it offers 30W output and DSP for $39.99, which is a better power-to-price ratio than the comiso (30W, $35.99) or the EDUPLINK (20W, $27.74) given its slightly higher aggregate rating. The Altec Lansing was a strong contender for extreme portability, but I preferred the higher audio output of the Raymate. The INSMY Retro was considered for indoor aesthetics, but for a general-purpose speaker, the IPX7 waterproof rating and stereo pairing of the Raymate made it the most versatile choice.
